title: Sources: Nvidia chips remain the norm for Chinese AI labs training LLMs, as switching from its CUDA platform to Huawei's CANN requires major code rewriting (South China Morning Post)
commentary: Export controls were supposed to accelerate China's chip independence, but CUDA lock-in is doing more to protect Nvidia's moat than any US trade policy. Rewriting your entire ML stack to run on Huawei hardware isn't a weekend project.
